business_summary: Primoris Services Corporation is a Texas-headquartered, NYSE-listed specialty contractor operating through Utilities, Energy, and Pipeline segments. Its Utilities segment builds and maintains electric transmission, substation and distribution infrastructure for utility customers, which is the mapped grid-interconnect exposure; its Energy segment (renewables, industrial, and gas-fired generation construction) sits outside the mapped chain.

exposure_summary.narrative: Primoris sits on grid-interconnect, scored UNDISCOVERED. Its second-quarter 2026 release reports a company-record total backlog of just under $13.9 billion (up roughly $2.2 billion from Q1), including about $1.5 billion of new utility-segment awards in the quarter, even as consolidated revenue fell 10.7% year over year and the company posted a net loss driven by weaker Energy-segment margins on challenged renewables projects, a segment outside the mapped exposure.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Primoris discloses segment-level backlog and new-award figures (Utilities segment: approximately $1.5 billion in new Q2 2026 awards) but not a data-center-specific revenue percentage; utility transmission and substation demand is driven by broad grid-reliability and load-growth spending, of which data centers are one named but unquantified contributor, per the located second-quarter 2026 release.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/PRIM.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/PRIM.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/PRIM.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 4485575299.04 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 7574900000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 4485575299.04 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 340500000, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth; a negative implied CAGR here reads as the market pricing in little to no FCF growth, or embedding a normalization of the current base-FCF level upward. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods (5y: -0.016, 7y: -0.0063, 10y: 0.001) in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon; inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

crowdedness_caveats: The grid-interconnect link is scored UNDISCOVERED at crowdedness 30, the chain's lowest retail-attention reading, though its capture score (40) is explicitly named as the chain's TRAP EXAMPLE: much of the link is regulated-return or competitively bid EPC, meaning volume growth does not automatically convert to proportional profit capture.
